_about: THE conversion rubric: how a Bad Eden mechanic written for RFI (the fourththing system) becomes its D&D 5E (dnd5e 6) twin. Read by tools/build-packs.mjs (the lint), bin/ft-convert-5e (the converter) and bin/ft-lint-parity (the parity check). Rendered for humans as CONVERSION_RUBRIC.md — keep the two in step. Every entry marked ruling:true was ruled by Dave; ruling:'owed' is a draft awaiting one.

sourceOfTruth.rule: Mechanics are authored ONCE. Anything shared by both flavours is authored in RFI canon (bbttcc-master-content/packs/_source + the fourththing engine banks) and flows through the converter into modules/bad-eden-5e/content/. Content that exists only in D&D (the SW5E-derived classes and powers) is authored in content/ and marked origin: 5e.
sourceOfTruth.link: every converted document carries flags.bad-eden-5e.rfi = { id: <source _id>, pack: <source pack>, hash: <rubric-output hash> } so the parity lint can tell missing / stale / orphaned

square.note: 1 square = 5 ft; '6 squares' → 30 ft; 'within 2 squares' → within 10 ft

scene.note: '1/Scene' and 'per scene' — a scene ≈ an encounter; short rest is the nearest 5E window

tier-uses.text: a number of uses equal to your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest

per-campaign-start.note: faction resource grants (Strategic Hooks) run in both flavours

small bonus / +1 rank (no rule behind it.note: Dave 2026-10-07: keep (+1d4 where the source rolls a die, e.g. Coalition Tongue)

stress points.to: 1d4 psychic damage when it bites; temp HP equal to your proficiency bonus when it heals

clarity.to: keep the word; a Clarity bonus becomes a Flow-point bonus (ae flags.bad-eden-5e.bonus.flow ADD n, n = the Clarity amount)
clarity.scale: Clarity is a 5-ish pool, Flow points are 4×level — see conditions.scarred for the bite scale

radiation.to: keep — bbttcc-radiation runs in both flavours; NOT a dnd5e damage type

defense check vs X.to: a saving throw of the mapped ability (see abilities); poison / disease / environmental → Constitution

your DC.to: 8 + your proficiency bonus + the feature's ability modifier (the ancestry lean, or the casting ability)

abilities._lineageLean: 'Lineage Lean toward X' → 'Ancestry Lean: <ability>' — no fixed score bonus in either flavour (backgrounds carry the increases)

ranks.gain a skill rank: proficiency; if already proficient → expertise; if already expert → Mastery

mastery.text: Mastery: on checks with that skill or tool, treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10

reroll-lowest.note: unconditional → AE; conditional ('vs poison', 'while unmoved') → text

3d10 keep lowest 2 / Imposed.to: disadvantage on the target's next attack roll or saving throw

banked reroll (_tq.bank).to: banked advantage: the next d20 roll you make (or hand to an ally) has advantage
banked reroll (_tq.bank).note: automation is a follow-up; text first

exploding d10.to: keep as a stated rule: 'on a 10, roll again and add'

minimum roll threshold.to: treat any 1 on the die as a 2

tiers.tierForLevel: 1–4 → I, 5–10 → II, 11–16 → III, 17+ → IV (RFI's own ladder; D&D's tiers of play)

radiation.to: the radiation ladder (bbttcc-radiation), never a damage type; 'radiation damage' in text → 'radiation exposure (one step on the ladder)'

energy (legacy, by flavor).to: the flavor's D&D type: lightning / fire / cold

true.to: damage that can't be reduced or prevented

staggered.to: speed halved and −2 to attack rolls until the end of its next turn (text)

scarred.to: keep the mark; the Clarity bite scales to the Flow pool: −1 Flow point per 5 points of your Flow maximum (minimum 1) until the end of the scene
scarred.ruling: owed — Dave asked whether −1 flat is enough; this is the proportional answer (Clarity ≈ a 5-point pool, so −1 Clarity ≈ 20%)

calmed.to: charmed (with the RFI wording: can't take violent action willingly)

burning.to: 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it uses an action to put it out

compelled.to: charmed, and it must spend at least one action each turn on the directive

dying.to: 0 hit points and death saving throws

surprised.to: surprised (can't act on the first round)

imposed.to: disadvantage on its next attack roll or saving throw

submerged / drowning / crushing.to: the 5E underwater and suffocation rules; crushing → 1d4 bludgeoning per turn unrated

jolted (SW5E shocked).to: can't take reactions until the start of its next turn

effects._about: what each RFI engine effect kind becomes on the 5E side. 'ae' = a transfer Active Effect on the feature; 'activity' = a dnd5e activity; 'text' = prose only (rider automation is a later pass)

rerolls[].to: unconditional (no vs/when) → advantage AE per rolls.reroll-lowest.ae; initiative → system.attributes.init.roll.mode ADD 1; conditional → text

grants.resistances[].flavor: a flavored entry ('energy'+'fire') maps through damage

grants.skills / ITEM_APTITUDE_GRANTS.to: proficiency via a Trait advancement (skills:<key> / tool:<key>); 'choice' → a Trait choice

triggers[] (chat-prompt).to: text — the prompt body is already the rule

resourceGrants[] (OP).to: text, verbatim, as a 'Strategic Hooks' feature — the faction layer runs in both flavours

_tq.temp(n).to: heal activity, healType temphp, formula per scalars

_tq.impose.to: disadvantage on the target's next attack roll or saving throw (text; rider later)

gear._about: RFI item → dnd5e item (the gear lane; drafted, not yet run)

weapon.damage.formula: dnd5e damage part (dice + bonus); '+N' flat bonuses are dropped unless the item is enhanced
weapon.damage.attribute: violence → Str melee / Dex finesse; intrigue → Dex ranged
weapon.category melee/ranged: weapon type simpleM/martialM/simpleR/martialR: martial = tagged heavy, two-handed, reach, or a firearm beyond a pistol; everything else simple (ruled 2026-10-07)

keep as a Bad Eden property in text

weapon.manifestation.tier: rarity: 1 uncommon, 2 rare, 3 very rare, 4 legendary

guardBonus.to: AC = 10 + guardBonus for light, 12 + bonus for medium, 14 + bonus for heavy — band by armorSkill/tags

armor.armorSkill: fitting → light, plating → medium/heavy, bracing → shield (ruled)

gear / equipment / consumable.type: loot | tool | consumable by category; 'potion' → consumable potion

price.marks: keep marks (both flavours); dnd5e price field = marks with denomination 'gp' labelled marks

creatures._about: RFI NPC/monster → dnd5e npc (the monster lane; drafted, not yet run). Budgets come from systems/fourththing/threat-chassis.js and the dnd5e-table-kit sim
creatures.lineage / creatureType: dnd5e creature type (humanoid, construct, fey, fiend, celestial, beast, monstrosity, aberration)
creatures.npcAuto rules: activities + AEs; what can't be modelled → feature text

vocabulary._about: text substitutions the converter applies before a human sees the draft, and the terms the lint refuses to ship
replace: you gain expertise with it instead
\bImpose the target: its next attack roll is 3d10 keep-lowest-2\b
the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll
give \1 disadvantage on its next attack roll or saving throw
vocabulary.squares: (\d+) squares? → N×5 feet (handled by the converter, not a plain substitution)
vocabulary.bannedFlags: i for the case-insensitive ones is decided by the tool: everything in banned is tested case-insensitively except the capitalised proper terms (Integrity, Violence…, VIO…)
keep: Steward? → character (RFI's word for a PC)

tokens.@ABILITY: the faculty in the match, through abilities (full name)
tokens.@SKILL: the skill in the match, through skills (full name)
tokens.@SAVE: Resolve → Wisdom, Evasion → Dexterity, Guard → (AC; no save)

vocabulary._order: front: grammatical reroll/rank rows · middle: the mechanics table · tail: bare capitalised faculty names (Violence→Strength …) so phrases like 'Presence (Persuasion) check' and 'Violence or Dexterity' resolve
vocabulary.lintScope: docs carrying flags.bad-eden-5e.rfi (RFI-origin) are linted for RFI vocabulary only; the Star Wars list applies to origin:5e content (classes, subclasses, powers) — a Bad Eden blaster is a Bad Eden blaster

_rulings.2026-10-07: Dave ruled rubric lines 1–8 (small bonus +2, Stress points, Clarity/Noise kept with Flow-point bonus, radiation stays a ladder, the skill table, armor bands, martial weapons, marks, creature scores 10+2×value). Scarred's scale is the one open question.
